summary: Iteration 4 - auth + per-user Mongo data. CRITICAL bug found & fixed by tester: GET /api/auth/me did not exist (404) although AuthContext calls it on load -> every page reload signed the user out. Added the route in auth.py (returns get_current_user). After fix: backend 19/19 pytest pass (register 200/409/422, login httpOnly access+refresh cookies, /auth/me cookie + Bearer fallback, refresh (refresh token rejected as access), logout clears session, lockout 429 after 5 fails on throwaway account, youtube search/video 401 unauth / 200 auth, status public, /me/data defaults, PUT queue validates 11-char id + dedupes, merge dedupes, settings quality 422 on invalid + persistence, 2-user isolation incl. ignored user_id param). bcrypt hash verified $2b$12$. Frontend all requested flows pass: logged-out Sign in button, Search opens auth-dialog ('Sign in to search YouTube.'), auth-error for wrong password and duplicate register, login closes dialog, session survives reload, search -> add-to-queue-prompt shown while playback continues, Add -> badge 1 & server queue 1; settings-account email, autoplay-related disabled when logged out, quality buttons + disclaimer, prompt toggle OFF -> search result auto-added (queue 1->2), settings persisted in Mongo and after reload; Next at end of queue -> toast 'Autoplay: Soft Jazz Piano...' and similar video played; logout -> signin shown, account queue not shown (local empty), /auth/me 401; seeded localStorage cpyt:queue + register new user -> server/drawer queue [LOCAL_A, LOCAL_B], no leak of driver's items; queue reorder/remove/clear (persisted to server); deep link /watch/M7lc1UVf-VE logged out loads iframe; fit modes, car mode, share toast, close-video back to home, /screen-size all work.

critical.issue: Route was missing (404) -> frontend lost session on every reload. FIXED by testing agent in /app/backend/auth.py; main agent please keep it.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True -> Starlette reflects ANY Origin (verified Origin: https://evil.com gets access-control-allow-origin: https://evil.com + allow-credentials:true). Set explicit origins (frontend URL) per auth playbook.

Lockout identifier uses first X-Forwarded-For value, which is client-spoofable -> attacker can rotate XFF to bypass the per IP+email lockout. Consider also an email-only counter or trusted proxy handling.

integration_issues.issue: Recently played list (LocalStorage) is not account-scoped: after logout / registering another user on the same device, the previous account's recently played videos are still shown on home. Consider clearing on logout or scoping per owner.

api.js interceptor skips refresh for any url starting with /auth/, so if access token (15m) is expired but refresh (7d) valid when the app loads, GET /auth/me 401 -> user shown as signed out instead of silently refreshing. Exempt /auth/me from the skip (only skip /auth/login,/auth/register,/auth/refresh).

action_items: Keep the added GET /api/auth/me route in auth.py (was missing)
Fix api.js 401 interceptor so /auth/me triggers refresh (otherwise users are logged out after 15 min on reload despite 7d refresh token)
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' with credentials
Optionally harden lockout against X-Forwarded-For spoofing
Scope or clear 'Recently played' on logout/account switch
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: missing /me route (fixed). No seed_admin present (not required - test user pre-exists).
CarPlayer.jsx is 768 lines (>700) - consider splitting playback/prompt/autoplay logic into hooks.
youtube_search/youtube_video are sync def using blocking requests -> run in threadpool by FastAPI, OK; async dependency works fine.
useAccountData: merge marks per-owner merged in localStorage; local queue is not cleared after merge, so on logout the local queue reappears (acceptable per spec but worth confirming).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (with noted minor issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_userdata.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Embedded YouTube iframe shows 'Video unavailable' in headless browser - environment limitation, player still initializes (duration loads). Sonner toasts last ~4s - poll quickly for 'Autoplay:' toast.
rca of the issue: AuthContext.jsx calls api.get('/auth/me') on mount, but create_auth() never registered a GET /me route -> 404 -> catch sets user=false. Login worked in-session because login response sets user directly, masking the bug until reload. Fix: added @router.get('/me') returning await get_current_user(request).
